ObjectName.value: Aerial view of Wake Island in July 2014

Categories.value: PD US Air Force|Aerial photographs of Wake Island

ImageDescription.value: Wake Island, pictured as viewed from the north on 20 July 2014, was completely evacuated on 15 July 2015, in preparation for Typhoon Halola closing in on the small atoll. A team with the 36th Contingency Response Group deployed from Andersen Air Force Base, Guam, to the atoll on 20 July 2015, to assist permanently assigned airfield staff in storm recovery efforts.

Credit.value: U.S. Air Force photo 140720-F-CH060-073

Artist.value: U.S. Air Force photo by Senior Airman Alexander W. Riedel
